description: A dice roller for any number of sides, rolled in your browser. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

dice.description: How many dice to roll, 1 to 100: the 2 in 2d6+3. Each roll comes back separately along with their subtotal.

modifier.description: A whole number added once to the total, not to each die: the +3 in 2d6+3. May be negative. Defaults to 0.

sides.description: Faces on each die, 2 to 1000: the 6 in 2d6+3. Every die rolls 1 to this number. Defaults to 6.

name: dice_roller
title: Dice Roller
